captures.notes: The street composition is legible, but the 9 m opening weakens the intended market-canyon enclosure.
The market edges work, but excessive clear width makes the row walls feel farther apart than the reference target.
The terraced east stalls inherit the 1.5 m building base and are visibly suspended above street level.
The covered table line is grounded, human-scaled, and visibly belongs beneath the facade gallery.
The opposing covered-market frontage has credible headroom and keeps the street centre traversable.
The camera begins too close to the gallery and bridge railing to evaluate the full circulation relationship.
The view is nearly inside the bridge slab, hiding its endpoint support and usable clearance.
The stair is present, but the tight view makes its ground-to-gallery landing relationship harder to judge.
Orange roofs render white and the unfenestrated upper side walls read as repeated blank panels.
Long upper elevations use blank wall modules, exposing the kit repetition before the town silhouette.
The missing orange atlas is obvious and the aligned upper shells do not yet produce facade overhang depth.

findings.evidence: The 9 m street plus shallow edge occupation leaves an over-broad centre band.
findings.invariant: The market street must read as a dense facade canyon at eye level.

findings.evidence: Every orange roof surface is untextured white while blue roof surfaces retain their atlas.
findings.invariant: Every baked structural material must be self-contained and preserve its authored palette.

findings.evidence: The cameras intersect or nearly intersect the reviewed gallery and bridge subjects.
findings.invariant: Each named review view must frame the complete structural relationship it claims to inspect.

findings.evidence: Market-stall feet on half-storey blocks begin 1.5 m above the street.
findings.invariant: Street markets remain grounded even when the inhabited shell sits on a terrace.

findings.evidence: Blank upper side panels and vertically aligned shells expose the repeated module grid.
findings.invariant: The continuous row should read as accumulated town fabric before it reads as repeated kit pieces.
